name: ticket-simulator
description: 活动票务演出票务经营模拟游戏 - Cocos Creator + TypeScript + Tiled

scripts.build: node ./node_modules/@cocos/creator/bin/creator build --project . --platform web-mobile || npm run build:web
scripts.build:creator: node ./node_modules/@cocos/creator/bin/creator build --project . --platform web-mobile
scripts.build:esbuild: npx esbuild ./assets/scripts/Bootstrap.ts --bundle --outfile=./dist/bundle.js --format=iife --global-name=TicketSim --platform=browser --tsconfig=./tsconfig.json --define:process.env.NODE_ENV=\"production\" || echo "esbuild fallback: please run 'npm i && npm run build:preview'"
scripts.preview: npm run build:web && npm run serve:web
scripts.typecheck: npx tsc --noEmit --project ./tsconfig.json 2>/dev/null || echo "TypeScript check (requires temp/tsconfig.cocos.json from editor)"
